docs.purpose: Lets a signed-in user view their own profile and free-trial status — viewing it auto-starts or auto-expires the trial as a side effect — and update profile fields such as name, phone, location, trade and notification preferences. A couple of one-time fields (trade selection, terms acceptance) can only be set once and then lock.
docs.data_story: It reads 2 tables — `user_profiles` and `entitlements` and writes `user_profiles` and `entitlements`. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 28 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 8 places: `mobile/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts`, `mobile/src/hooks/usePatchProfile.ts`, `mobile_onboarding_address`, `mobile_onboarding_complete`, `mobile_onboarding_profession`, `mobile_onboarding_supplier`, `mobile_onboarding_terms`, `web_subscribe_success`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: Also cites 96_mobile_subscription.md §10 Step 4 and 116_multi_product_architecture.md §4. GET issues writes as a side effect (trial fallback-init and trial expiration via src/lib/subscription/expiration.ts, which reads/writes entitlements and reads user_profiles), so the response sets Cache-Control: no-store. PATCH uses an atomic-precondition UPDATE (WHERE trade_slug IS NULL) to close a race on the immutable first write of trade_slug, returning 409 on race loss; tos_accepted_at is likewise immutable once set. The response whitelist replaced a prior SELECT * that leaked stripe_customer_id and admin-internal columns. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: GET PROJECTION IS EXACTLY 28 TOP-LEVEL FIELDS (26 from user_profiles + 2 from the LEFT JOINed lead_gen entitlements row), enumerated above. Deliberately EXCLUDED as internal (src/lib/userProfile.schema.ts:69-70): stripe_customer_id, radius_cap_km, trade_slugs_override. A zero-entitlement user serialises subscription_status: null and trial_started_at: null because the join is a LEFT JOIN (src/lib/entitlements/index.ts:68) — never an omitted key. PATCH can write 20 user_profiles columns, enumerated with per-line citations in `writes`; note account_preset (:355) is server-DERIVED via deriveAccountPreset (src/lib/classification/account-preset.ts:42-46) and only when the existing value is NULL (:353) — it is not in the Zod schema and cannot be set by a client. The GET fires two entitlement WRITES before the read (:72-73), which is why no-store is mandatory (:29-32). UNRESEARCHED: the census's claim that this route is reached from 8 consumers 'by two idioms' — I did not open any of the consumer files listed in routes-index.json (mobile hooks / onboarding screens / web_subscribe_success); that claim is unverified by me. CENSUS AGREEMENT on tables: matches (reads user_profiles + entitlements; writes user_profiles + entitlements). | Idempotency: GET is write-bearing but idempotent: applyFallbackTrialInitIfNeeded is an INSERT...SELECT gated by NOT EXISTS plus ON CONFLICT (user_id, product) DO NOTHING (src/lib/subscription/expiration.ts:60-62), and applyTrialExpirationIfNeeded only matches rows still in status='trial' past the 14-day window (src/lib/subscription/expiration.ts:92-95) — a second call matches nothing. PATCH is idempotent: all writes are absolute field assignments (:301-304), the trade_slug first-write is an atomic-precondition UPDATE that 409s the loser instead of overwriting (:384-386, :396-400), tos_accepted_at is immutable once set (:235-248), and initTrialEntitlement is ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (src/lib/entitlements/index.ts:202). The user_profiles UPDATE and the trial INSERT share one transaction (:391-406). | Caching: GET: `Cache-Control: no-store` — constant at src/app/api/user-profile/route.ts:46, attached on the 404 (:80), the 403 (:102), the 200 (:111) and the 500 (:117). PATCH responses carry NO cache header (:372, :443, and every PATCH error branch). | Entitlement posture: No gate on access, but the route DRIVES the entitlement lifecycle: GET calls applyFallbackTrialInitIfNeeded (:72) and applyTrialExpirationIfNeeded (:73) before the SELECT; PATCH calls initTrialEntitlement on onboarding completion (:401-403, condition at :366-367). Account-state gates instead of entitlement gates: account_deleted_at -> 403 on GET (:86-104) and PATCH (:158-163). | Other guards / classification: Two immutability fences and one race fence: trade_slug is first-write-only and the write carries an atomic precondition `WHERE user_id = $1 AND trade_slug IS NULL` (:384-386) with rowCount 0 -> 409 (:396-400, :408-428); tos_accepted_at is immutable once set (:235-248); radius_km is clamped server-side to user_profiles.radius_cap_km via Math.min (:327-333). | Locking tests: src/tests/user-profile-trial.infra.test.ts, src/tests/user-profiles.infra.test.ts, src/tests/user-profiles.security.test.ts.
